free_tier_limits.correction: Developer plan: free for up to 10 development devices, exclusively for teams building on Nordic low-power wireless solutions; usage beyond 10 devices is pay-as-you-go.

rate_limits.correction: Published and endpoint-specific: heartbeat ingestion and Latest Release calls are limited to 100 per device per 24 hours; Custom Data Recordings to 1 per device per 24 hours and 16 MB; session limits depend on the plan.

notes: The API is operational and the api.memfault.com host is official, but its bare root is not a documented operation, so a root 404 does not invalidate the base URL. The submitted documentation URL is obsolete and currently returns 404; the current REST API documentation is at /api.
